explore.coast: Ooh, Lake Erie shapes this stretch of Ohio, from Cleveland’s waterfront to the islands offshore.
explore.cities: Columbus, Cincinnati, and Dayton each offer a different way into Ohio’s city life—which one should we explore first?
explore.hills: Southeastern Ohio’s ridges and valleys lead to Appalachian communities and the sandstone gorges of Hocking Hills. Sounds like a lovely detour, right?
explore.wild: Wetlands, forest paths, and the Cuyahoga River give us plenty of reasons to slow down outdoors. Let’s take our time. ♡
explore.past: Indigenous histories, migration, industry, and reform all shaped the Ohio people know today.
explore.symbols: A swallow-tailed flag, a northern cardinal, and a buckeye tree are among Ohio’s familiar emblems. ♡

make.factory: Ohio’s factories connect materials and skilled work to vehicles, chemicals, and the products people use every day. Let’s see how those pieces come together!
make.flight: Aircraft take a whole network of people and places: researchers, precision suppliers, testing teams, and makers. Come trace those connections with me!
make.lab: Ohio’s labs, hospitals, and technology teams turn research into tools for care, industry, and everyday work. Curious how it all connects?
make.farm: A trip from field to grocery shelf passes through farms, processors, cold storage, and delivery routes. So many stops before lunch!
make.movement: Ports, roads, rail lines, and airports connect Ohio’s work to customers near and far. Let’s trace the route!
make.work: Factories, farms, hospitals, and offices make up Ohio’s economy. Wages, housing, and travel time shape how that work feels at home—let’s keep the people in view.

culture.records: Cleveland’s rock legacy is one part of a music story still heard on local stages and recordings. Come find a sound you love. ♡
culture.gallery: The Hopewell earthworks carry enduring Indigenous meaning, while galleries and museums share many other Ohio stories.
culture.table: Chili, goetta, markets, and family recipes show how Ohio’s food traditions change from place to place. Come hungry, okay?
culture.game: Games, festivals, and local celebrations bring neighbors together well beyond the final score. I love that part most. ♡
culture.words: Accents, place names, and the languages spoken at home reveal how many voices Ohio holds. Which ones will you hear?
culture.invention: Dayton’s aviation story began with patient experiments, practical skills, and a bicycle shop. What a start!

live.campus: Colleges, schools, research labs, and career programs offer many ways to keep learning in Ohio. Which path catches your eye?
live.library: Ohio’s libraries offer books, digital resources, local history, and places to learn together. Let’s see what we find!
live.civic: Ohio’s executive, legislative, and judicial branches each have a distinct role in public decisions.
live.local: Counties, cities, villages, and townships handle many decisions made closer to home. Let’s see how local government works.
live.community: Local groups, festivals, faith communities, and volunteers help turn a place into a neighborhood. Let’s meet them. ♡
